about: Karmic Threads for all 30 launch heroines: two to four ties each. Fielding tied heroines grants Resonance (+5% Attack) and unlocks their camp talk in Secret Realms.

records.story: Frostpeak's two finest swords have dueled forty-nine times without settling anything; Shang Jianlan was away on a sword pilgrimage when the sect was betrayed, and has not forgiven herself for it.

campTalk.speaker: hero:shang_jianlan
campTalk.text: Forty-nine bouts. Twenty-four each and one draw. Tomorrow, at dawn.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
campTalk.text: You said that last week.

campTalk.speaker: hero:shang_jianlan
campTalk.text: And you overslept. Plum blossoms bloom in winter, Ling Shuang, not at noon.

records.story: Plum and Orchid swore sisterhood with Chrysanthemum under the Gentlemen's Pact, and keep a fourth seat empty for the bamboo who has not yet been found.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gu_youlan
campTalk.text: Three cups poured. Four places set.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
campTalk.text: The bamboo will come. The Pact was made for four.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gu_youlan
campTalk.text: Then I will keep playing until she hears it.

records.story: Ju Yannian has treated every frostbite and sword cut Ling Shuang ever earned, and both their flowers are praised in poems for defying the frost.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ju_yannian
campTalk.text: Sit. Tongue out. You haven't slept since the pass, have you?

campTalk.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
campTalk.text: Frost doesn't sleep.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ju_yannian
campTalk.text: Frost isn't my patient. Drink. All of it.

records.story: Orchid plays and Chrysanthemum brews: the Gentlemen's Pact meets over tea whenever the war allows.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ju_yannian
campTalk.text: Too much ginseng in your tea makes your playing sharp.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gu_youlan
campTalk.text: My playing is sharp because Ling Shuang keeps cutting my strings.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ju_yannian
campTalk.text: Then she drinks the bitter pot tonight.

records.story: Mo Yingyue taught Li Qianshu how to vanish; Qianshu is still working on the quiet part.

campTalk.speaker: hero:li_qianshu
campTalk.text: Senior Sister! I built a case that fires three hundred needles!

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: Does it fire them quietly?

campTalk.speaker: hero:li_qianshu
campTalk.text: ...It plays a little tune first.

records.story: Madam Yue sent Gu Youlan to bring the contract-breaker home; she came back alone, with a bag of candied hawthorns and a report that said only: the contract held a lie.

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: You could have dragged me back, you know.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gu_youlan
campTalk.text: The code binds the honest. Your client was not.

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: So that's a no on sharing the hawthorns.

records.story: The fox and the assassin keep landing on the same rooftop, and each insists she was there first.

campTalk.speaker: hero:hu_qiangwei
campTalk.text: Darling, black is so dreary. Let me dress you in red.

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: Red shows blood. Yours or mine?

campTalk.speaker: hero:hu_qiangwei
campTalk.text: Ooh. You do flirt, in your way.

records.story: The Phoenix Palace's two prodigies argue every day about whose fire is older, the sun's or the phoenix's.

campTalk.speaker: hero:sang_chaoxi
campTalk.text: The sun was rising long before any phoenix learned to burn.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
campTalk.text: And the phoenix rises from its own ashes. Can your sun do that?

campTalk.speaker: hero:sang_chaoxi
campTalk.text: Every morning, Feihong. Every single morning.

records.story: Born in the same fire month, Zhu Liuhuo and Yan Feihong swore sisterhood over a burnt banquet that neither will explain.

campTalk.speaker: hero:zhu_liuhuo
campTalk.text: Sister! Race you to the boss!

campTalk.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
campTalk.text: Last one there scrubs the cauldron.

campTalk.speaker: hero:zhu_liuhuo
campTalk.text: You said that at the banquet. Look how that ended.

records.story: Fang Yanzhi has treated Yan Feihong's burns since they were apprentices, and has never once been thanked out loud.

campTalk.speaker: hero:fang_yanzhi
campTalk.text: Hands out. You singed yourself again.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
campTalk.text: It's my own fire. It doesn't count.

campTalk.speaker: hero:fang_yanzhi
campTalk.text: It counts when it blisters. And a little rouge, while I'm here.

records.story: The temple's gate guardian and its healer: one keeps danger out, the other mends whatever gets in anyway.

campTalk.speaker: hero:jiang_yulan
campTalk.text: Stay behind me tomorrow, Sister Lianhua.

campTalk.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
campTalk.text: I'll stay beside you. A healer has to see the wounds.

campTalk.speaker: hero:jiang_yulan
campTalk.text: ...Then I won't take any.

records.story: In the Garden their flowers grew at the two ends of the Jade Pool, the lotus in the warm shallows and the snow lotus on the frozen rock, and each still dreams of the other.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: You smell like warm water. I used to dream of that smell.

campTalk.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
campTalk.text: And I of snow. I always wanted to visit your end of the pool.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: It was cold. You would have liked it. Briefly.

records.story: Shang Jianlan once climbed the crane cliffs at midnight to train in silence, and Gui Chanjuan let her stay, which she has let no one else do.

campTalk.speaker: hero:shang_jianlan
campTalk.text: The moon is bright tonight.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gui_chanjuan
campTalk.text: That is talking.

campTalk.speaker: hero:shang_jianlan
campTalk.text: ...It's still bright.

records.story: Zhu Liuhuo has challenged Tang Mian to eleven duels, and Tang Mian has won all eleven without fully waking up.

campTalk.speaker: hero:zhu_liuhuo
campTalk.text: Duel me! Properly this time!

campTalk.speaker: hero:tang_mian
campTalk.text: Mm... was I awake for the last one?

campTalk.speaker: hero:zhu_liuhuo
campTalk.text: THAT IS THE PROBLEM!

records.story: Tang Mian is the Guild heiress's personal bodyguard, which mostly means napping in the corridor outside Wei Zi's door.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wei_zi
campTalk.text: My guard is asleep on the cargo again.

campTalk.speaker: hero:tang_mian
campTalk.text: I'm guarding it. From the inside of my eyelids.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wei_zi
campTalk.text: ...Someone fetch her a cushion. The good one.

records.story: The Queen of Flowers and the Crimson Thorn Fox each believe the other is the second most beautiful woman alive.

campTalk.speaker: hero:hu_qiangwei
campTalk.text: Purple again, Wei Zi? Bold, with your complexion.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wei_zi
campTalk.text: Red again, fox? Do you own anything that isn't a warning?

campTalk.speaker: hero:hu_qiangwei
campTalk.text: Darling. I am the warning.

records.story: An Baihe grew up in the Guild hall beside the heiress, and has been trying to find Wei Zi a worthy suitor ever since.

campTalk.speaker: hero:an_baihe
campTalk.text: I've found you the perfect match! Handsome, rich, very patient.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wei_zi
campTalk.text: Patient is the worst thing you could have said. Next.

campTalk.speaker: hero:an_baihe
campTalk.text: I'm putting you down as extremely difficult. Again.

records.story: Cousins of the Fox Clan: Wen Xingyu pours the wine, Hu Qiangwei breaks the hearts, and Lady Hu Qiao blames them both.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wen_xingyu
campTalk.text: Cousin! The tavern's full of heartbroken scholars again. Your doing?

campTalk.speaker: hero:hu_qiangwei
campTalk.text: They came for your wine. They stayed for me.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wen_xingyu
campTalk.text: Then they pay double.

records.story: Yu Lei is certain the Apricot Blossom Village tavern is haunted by a fox spirit; she is right, and the fox spirit keeps serving her free plum soup.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yu_lei
campTalk.text: I know you're a fox! Peachwood charm, begone!

campTalk.speaker: hero:wen_xingyu
campTalk.text: Mm, that tickles. Plum soup, little exorcist?

campTalk.speaker: hero:yu_lei
campTalk.text: ...Is it the one with the sugar?

records.story: Wen Xingyu took on the clan's hopeless case and is still trying to teach Du Tihong a single illusion.

campTalk.speaker: hero:wen_xingyu
campTalk.text: Again. Picture a peony, then show it to me.

campTalk.speaker: hero:du_tihong
campTalk.text: I'm picturing it! It's so beautiful! I'm crying!

campTalk.speaker: hero:wen_xingyu
campTalk.text: Lovely, darling. It's still a rock.

records.story: Yu Lei covers the temple gate in peachwood talismans every morning, and Jiang Yulan, who guards that gate, ends up wearing most of them.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yu_lei
campTalk.text: Hold still, Sister Yulan, there's a spirit on your back!

campTalk.speaker: hero:jiang_yulan
campTalk.text: That is the fourth talisman today.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yu_lei
campTalk.text: And no spirit has got you, has it?

records.story: Xuan Wangyou took in the little orphan from the ford orchards, and Yu Lei still keeps a talisman on the kitchen door to keep her safe.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xuan_wangyou
campTalk.text: Have you eaten, Lei'er?

campTalk.speaker: hero:yu_lei
campTalk.text: Twice! And I warded the pot so no ghost can steal the soup.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xuan_wangyou
campTalk.text: So that's why the lid won't open.

records.story: Lan Yuan carries letters to the Moonshadow Pavilion, and Li Qianshu is the only one who ever notices her arrive.

campTalk.speaker: hero:li_qianshu
campTalk.text: Yuan! I heard you come in!

campTalk.speaker: hero:lan_yuan
campTalk.text: Nobody hears me come in.

campTalk.speaker: hero:li_qianshu
campTalk.text: Your sleeve rustles in a minor key. I built a thing that listens.

records.story: The Tianji Pavilion's courier and its scribe: one carries the secrets, the other writes them down very neatly.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ning_suxin
campTalk.text: You resealed this letter, Lan Yuan.

campTalk.speaker: hero:lan_yuan
campTalk.text: ...It was already open.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ning_suxin
campTalk.text: It was not. I sealed it. My seals are perfect.

records.story: Ning Suxin records every reading Ying Wucai gives, which is hard, because the oracle changes her mind with the weather.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ning_suxin
campTalk.text: Yesterday you said the omen was blue. Today it's pink?

campTalk.speaker: hero:ying_wucai
campTalk.text: It rained in the night. The soil changed.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ning_suxin
campTalk.text: I'm writing 'see weather' in the margin. Again.

records.story: In the Garden the narcissus pool watered the hydrangea bed: one flower learned to reflect, the other to change.

campTalk.speaker: hero:bai_lingbo
campTalk.text: Show me your colour today, Wucai.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ying_wucai
campTalk.text: Whatever yours is. You know that.

campTalk.speaker: hero:bai_lingbo
campTalk.text: Then we match. How lovely to look at.

records.story: Chief Bai Lin's granddaughter and the clan's poisoner grew up in the same marsh, and She Qingzhu has never once poisoned Lingbo's tea, a fact she mentions often.

campTalk.speaker: hero:she_qingzhu
campTalk.text: Tea, Lingbo? It's safe, I promise. Probably.

campTalk.speaker: hero:bai_lingbo
campTalk.text: You say that every time.

campTalk.speaker: hero:she_qingzhu
campTalk.text: And every time you've lived. You're welcome.

records.story: Teng Yin swore to Chief Bai Lin that she would guard his granddaughter, and has been coiled protectively around her ever since.

campTalk.speaker: hero:teng_yin
campTalk.text: Stay in my shade, Lingbo. The sun is harsh today.

campTalk.speaker: hero:bai_lingbo
campTalk.text: It's raining, Teng Yin.

campTalk.speaker: hero:teng_yin
campTalk.text: Then stay closer.

records.story: Teng Yin scolds the clan's poisoner like an elder sister, and She Qingzhu lets her, because nobody else dares.

campTalk.speaker: hero:teng_yin
campTalk.text: Qingzhu. What did you put in the cakes?

campTalk.speaker: hero:she_qingzhu
campTalk.text: A little something. For flavour.

campTalk.speaker: hero:teng_yin
campTalk.text: Say cinnamon, or I start squeezing.

records.story: For every poison She Qingzhu brews, Ju Yannian brews the antidote, and both of them keep score.

campTalk.speaker: hero:she_qingzhu
campTalk.text: I made a new one. It smells of osmanthus. Lovely, isn't it?

campTalk.speaker: hero:ju_yannian
campTalk.text: The antidote is already steeping. Ninety-three to ninety-two.

campTalk.speaker: hero:she_qingzhu
campTalk.text: Ninety-two? You counted the cough syrup!

records.story: When Du Tihong wept blood after a battle (a cuckoo thing), Fang Yanzhi stopped it, and the fox has trailed her medic like a grateful puppy ever since.

campTalk.speaker: hero:du_tihong
campTalk.text: Yanzhi! No blood today! Only regular tears!

campTalk.speaker: hero:fang_yanzhi
campTalk.text: Good. Come here, those I can fix with a little rouge.

records.story: The Guild's tea house and its matchmaker share a back door, a gossip habit and a great deal of spilled tea.

campTalk.speaker: hero:an_baihe
campTalk.text: That scholar came back again. Third time this week. For the tea?

campTalk.speaker: hero:lin_chaxue
campTalk.text: Nobody comes back for my tea.

campTalk.speaker: hero:an_baihe
campTalk.text: Exactly. I'm writing his name down.

records.story: Xue Lianxin's first stop in the lowlands was Lin Chaxue's tea house, where she drank a tea so bad that she swore sisterhood with the brewer on the spot.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: Brew me the bad tea again, Chaxue.

campTalk.speaker: hero:lin_chaxue
campTalk.text: It's not bad! ...It's a little bad.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: It's hot. That is all I ask of tea.

records.story: Two recluses of the crane cliffs: Gui Chanjuan watched Xue Lianxin grow up on the next ledge and never once said hello, which both consider a close friendship.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: Chanjuan. The lowlands are warm, and loud.

campTalk.speaker: hero:gui_chanjuan
campTalk.text: I know. That is why I stayed up here.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: You came down anyway.

records.story: Qiao Lingxiao has begged Gui Chanjuan to teach her to fly every day for three years; the recluse has never said no, which Lingxiao counts as yes.

campTalk.speaker: hero:qiao_lingxiao
campTalk.text: Shifu! Today is the day you teach me to fly!

campTalk.speaker: hero:gui_chanjuan
campTalk.text: I never agreed to be your teacher.

campTalk.speaker: hero:qiao_lingxiao
campTalk.text: You never said no! That's a thousand days of yes!

records.story: Nestmates on the crane cliffs: Xue Lianxin was the only one who never laughed when Qiao Lingxiao climbed instead of flying.

campTalk.speaker: hero:qiao_lingxiao
campTalk.text: Lianxin! I climbed the north face! Without falling! Much!

campTalk.speaker: hero:xue_lianxin
campTalk.text: I saw. You fell twice.

campTalk.speaker: hero:qiao_lingxiao
campTalk.text: Climbing back up counts double.

records.story: Sang Chaoxi wakes before the sun to greet it, and the only one ever up before her is Xuan Wangyou, already cooking breakfast.

campTalk.speaker: hero:sang_chaoxi
campTalk.text: Up, everyone! The sun is... oh. You're up.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xuan_wangyou
campTalk.text: Congee's ready. Sit.

campTalk.speaker: hero:sang_chaoxi
campTalk.text: One day I'll wake before you, Wangyou.

records.story: When the wraiths burned Peach Blossom Ford, Su Lianhua shielded the refugees while Xuan Wangyou fed them; the Jade Lotus Temple calls them its two hands.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xuan_wangyou
campTalk.text: Lianhua, you skipped supper to tend the wounded again.

campTalk.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
campTalk.text: They needed me more than the soup did.

campTalk.speaker: hero:xuan_wangyou
campTalk.text: The soup disagrees. Sit. Eat. Then heal.

records.story: Ling Shuang has slept with her sword unsheathed since the assassin who was paid to kill their master joined the Pavilion; Mo Yingyue finds this deeply flattering.

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: You can put the sword down. If I wanted the Pavilion Master dead, I'd have finished in chapter three.

campTalk.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
campTalk.text: Then I will keep it drawn until chapter four.

campTalk.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
campTalk.text: Charming. Want a candied hawthorn? No? More for me.

records.story: In the dream of the Garden, Lotus and Phoenix stood side by side, fire feeding earth; in this life Yan Feihong keeps setting Su Lianhua's tea alight, and Su keeps healing the burns.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
campTalk.text: I was only warming it! Tea should be hot.

campTalk.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
campTalk.text: It was hot. Now it is charcoal. Give me your hand, you singed your fingers again.

campTalk.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
campTalk.text: ...It doesn't hurt. Much. Thank you, Lotus.
